scope: Durable per-side preparation and explicit single-use authorization for an already persisted partial expense adjustment
checks: Reads execute outside database transactions, along fixed original finance destinations
Claim does not mark original payment or vouchers unknown while another side is legitimately queued
Ready evidence never creates a command until its original independent finance actor explicitly authorizes
Authorization preserves the successful peer and creates a permanent distinct command for the selected side
Earliest original bank, accrual, payment-voucher and period expiry limits authorization to at most five minutes
Changed original facts, revoked finance, old candidate, wrong actor and expired evidence block authorization
Concurrent authorization permits one consumer; failed final proof insertion rolls back preparation, root, revision and command
Original read failures preserve the actual unknown state and separately accepted original observations
Closed accounting period retains actual original observations but creates no authorized command
Expired lease and late finish cannot overwrite original facts or a newer preparation state
Zero-payable adjustments complete both sides and restore advance offsets without a bank transaction
Authorized history replays both preparation and adjustment adjacent revisions
Migration retains old finance facts and partial completion proofs; database constraints bind actual revisions and single-use identity

historyProofRegression.fix: Read both actual preparation revisions, validate tenant/id/version, replay ready-to-authorized and require equality with the root and authorized history

remaining: Public initial intent creation and original-fact refresh entry before first adjustment
Explicit dispute decisions, public role/field access, idempotency/audit and API/UI
Nonempty long-lived runtime upgrade, HTTP/browser/restart and file preservation acceptance
